| Size | 4 |

## Where to find it

Not found as loot.

- Lies at 31 fixed spots in the world (GTA's own boxes, crates and bags), put back a while after it is taken.

## Crafting

No recipe makes or uses it.

## Scrap

Cannot be scrapped: a Scrap Machine destroys it, see [Scrap](Scrap).
